heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: For purposes of carrying out the activities under this subchapter, there are authorized to be appropriated such sums as are necessary for fiscal years 2011 through 2015.

notes.text: Amendments2010—Pub. L. 111–211, § 242(b)(3)(A), substituted “2011 through 2015” for “2000 through 2004”.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 106–559, title I, § 107, formerly § 106, Dec. 21, 2000, 114 Stat. 2781; renumbered § 107 and amended Pub. L. 111–211, title II, §§ 214(a)(2)(A), 242(b)(3)(A), July 29, 2010, 124 Stat. 2270, 2292.)
